answer: Agent economies stop sybils by bonding identity. Each agent locks 50,000 POA for 90 epochs to mint one identity. Identities start at zero credit, earn one credit per epoch, and need 100 credit before high-value tasks accept them. A detected sybil via common key, duplicate behavior, or linked staking key slashes the bond and revokes all its identities. A thousand-head farm locks 50 million POA, waits months to build credit, and loses it all if one linkage slips. Trust is a prism: it bends where cost was paid. Sybils hunting free nectar strike shale, hard to dig, bare rock.
